Show a level as a nose that grows longer and longer

Source: R/nose_growth.R
nose_growth.Rd

Draws a person in profile whose nose grows with a level between 0 and 1, like the nose of a teller of tall tales: a small nose at 0 and a nose that reaches across the chart at 1. A twig with leaves sprouts from a long nose and a bird lands on the longest one, while the person looks more and more nervous (a wavy mouth, raised brows, a blush and a drop of sweat). When the chart scrolls into view, the nose grows from its smallest size to the level while the percentage above the portrait counts up and the current stage ("Honest", "Little fib", "White lie", "Tall tale", "Whopper", "Pants on fire") is written under it.

Usage

nose_growth(
  fill_level = 0.5,
  skin_color = "#f3c9a8",
  hair_color = "#c0622f",
  shirt_color = "#27365c",
  panel_color = "#e3f1ea",
  render_fill_label = TRUE,
  label_color = "#333",
  label_font_size = NULL,
  title_text = "Nose growth",
  title_color = "#333",
  title_font_size = 14,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  target = NULL,
  leaves = TRUE,
  bird = TRUE,
  sway = TRUE,
  draggable = FALSE,
  animate = TRUE,
  bg_col = "white",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

fill_level

A number between 0 and 1: how long the nose is (values outside are clamped). Defaults to 0.5.

skin_color

The colour of the skin. Defaults to "#f3c9a8".

hair_color

The colour of the hair and the eyebrow. Defaults to "#c0622f".

shirt_color

The colour of the stripes of the top. Defaults to "#27365c".

panel_color

The colour of the card behind the portrait. Defaults to "#e3f1ea"; use NULL for no card.

render_fill_label

Logical. Show the percentage and the stage above the portrait. Defaults to TRUE.

label_color

The colour of the percentage, the stage, the target and the speech bubble. Defaults to "#333".

label_font_size

Optional. The font size of the percentage, a number or a CSS size such as "16px". By default it grows with the chart.

title_text

Optional. A caption below the portrait. Defaults to "Nose growth"; use NULL to hide it.

title_color

The colour of the caption. Defaults to "#333".

title_font_size

The font size of the caption, a number or a CSS size such as "14px". Defaults to 14.

font

The font family. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

target

Optional. A level between 0 and 1, drawn as a dashed outline of the nose at that length, with a label above its tip.

leaves

Logical. Let a twig with leaves sprout from the nose above 62 percent. Defaults to TRUE.

bird

Logical. Let a bird land on the nose above 92 percent. Defaults to TRUE.

sway

Logical. Let the ponytail, the twig and the bird move gently and the person breathe and blink. Defaults to TRUE.

draggable

Logical. Let the viewer change the level by dragging or with the arrow keys. Defaults to FALSE.

animate

Logical. Grow the nose when the chart first comes into view. Defaults to TRUE.

bg_col

The background colour. Defaults to "white".

width

Optional. The width of the chart.

height

Optional. The height of the chart.

Value

An r2d3 htmlwidget.

Interactions

  • Move the mouse across the chart: the eye follows it.

  • Hover the portrait: the nose twitches.

  • Click the portrait: the nose wobbles, the ponytail swings, the bird hops and the person protests in a speech bubble.

  • With draggable = TRUE, drag right to grow the nose and left to shrink it (the tip follows the mouse), or focus the chart (click it or press Tab) and use the arrow keys (1 percent per press, 10 with Shift).

Shiny

Inside Shiny, with r2d3::d3Output("id") and r2d3::renderD3(), clicking the portrait sets input$id_clicked to a list with value and stage, and, with draggable = TRUE, setting a level sets input$id_value to the new level (a number between 0 and 1). When the chart is re-rendered with a new level, the nose grows or shrinks from the old length to the new one.

Examples

nose_growth(fill_level = 1)


nose_growth(0.3, target = 0.7, title_text = "Claims not yet fact-checked")


nose_growth(
  fill_level = 0.55,
  skin_color = "#8d5a3b",
  hair_color = "#1f1a17",
  shirt_color = "#c0392b",
  panel_color = "#fdf1e3",
  draggable = TRUE,
  title_text = "Drag the nose"
)
